trigger.reason: First numerically accepted capture to fail manual visual QC.

scope.description: Formalizes the final decision, counting, and logging behavior for manual visual-QC failures.

numerically_accepted.pass_rule: All 12 selected relations must show both projected object regions sufficiently visible and consistent with their annotations.
numerically_accepted.fail_rule: Reject the entire capture when at least one selected relation contains a materially occluded, truncated, mismatched, or visually unidentifiable target region.

log_schema.capture_accepted: Final result after manual visual QC.
log_schema.legacy_compatibility: Schema-1.0 rows are accepted only when selection_accepted is true and visual_qc is pass.
